# has region

Relates an image to a region within it. Non-functional: an image may have many regions. Inverse of gmeow:regionOf.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRegion>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasRegion`  

**Type:** `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/images>
